verdict.rationale: The GST portal handles taxpayer data, so asking whether it lets users keep that data out of AI training is a fair privacy-posture question. However, the evidence pack covers only registration, returns, payments, appeals and other tax workflows. Nothing documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy or any related privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
